ننفصل (form VII)
# نَنْفَصِلُ (nanfaṣilu) /nan.fa.sˤi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# نَنْفَصِلَ (nanfaṣila) /nan.fa.sˤi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
# نَنْفَصِلْ (nanfaṣil) /nan.fa.sˤil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَصَلَ (infaṣala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
